h5Necropolis3rdBanshee.description:
Wights, Wraiths and Banshees are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature). Wraiths also have {Harm Touch} (kills at least 1 creature of the target and dispels its beneficial spells). Banshees also have {Death Wail} (damages living enemies within 3 hexes; the lower their Morale and the closer they are, the more it hurts).

Banshees instill fear deep in the soul of every living thing; anyone who hears a Banshee's scream drops dead on the spot. On the battlefield, Banshees also claim more victims with the rusty scimitars in their hands.

See also {Wight}, {Wraith}.

h5Necropolis3rdDiseaseZombie.description:
Walking Dead, Zombies and Rot Zombies are the level 2 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature) and {Enrage} (Attack rises when a friendly stack dies). Zombies also have {Weakening Strike} (attacks give the target -2 Attack and -2 Defense, cumulative). Rot Zombies also have {Festering Aura} (adjacent non-undead stacks get -3 Attack, -2 Defense and -1 Morale).

For the living, nothing is more revolting than becoming a Rot Zombie. These servants of the necromancers, stinking and covered in disease-ridden rotting flesh, need only appear on the battlefield for their enemies to feel that victory is hopeless and lose the courage to fight on.

See also {Walking Dead}, {Zombie}.

h5Necropolis3rdHorrorDragon.description:
Bone Dragons, Spectral Dragons and Horror Dragons are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them fly, are Dragons and have {Undead} (undead creature). Spectral Dragons also have {Cursing Attack} (casts Weakness on the target when attacking) and {Death Stare} (-1 Morale to all enemies). Horror Dragons also have {Sorrow Strike} (casts Sorrow on the target when attacking).

Ancient tombs lie hidden in bottomless swamps, and Horror Dragons lurk beneath this cursed mire. The rising poisonous fumes cannot taint them, but few witnesses have ever returned alive to tell these tales.

See also {Bone Dragon}, {Spectral Dragon}.

h5Necropolis3rdLichMaster.description:
Liches, Archliches and Lich Masters are the level 5 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have a ranged attack and {Undead} (undead creature). Liches have {Death Cloud} (when shooting, non-undead stacks around the target take 50% damage). Archliches can also cast {Weakness}, {Decay} and {Suffering} (4 times per battle, 16 mana) and have {Death Cloud} (when shooting, non-undead stacks around the target take 50% damage). Lich Masters can also cast {Suffering} and {Animate Dead} (3 times per battle, 19 mana).

The most experienced wizards are honored to become Lich Masters after death, leading the mighty legions of necromancers.

See also {Lich}, {Archlich}.

bonus.description:
{Siege Shooter}
No damage loss when shooting over walls

h5Necropolis3rdNosferatu.description:
Vampires, Vampire Lords and Nosferatu are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature) and {Life Drain} (drains life equal to 50% of the damage dealt and can resurrect creatures in its own stack). Vampires have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Vampire Lords can also teleport and have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Nosferatu can also teleport and have {Sleeping Strike} (melee attacks have a chance to put the target to sleep for 2 rounds; hitting a sleeping target deals maximum damage).

Never look a Nosferatu in the eye; sadly, not everyone remembers this basic rule. Any arrogant fool who tries to defy it is certain to fall into a sleep from which he never wakes, surrounded by vampires.

See also {Vampire}, {Vampire Lord}.

bonus.description:
{No Retaliation}

h5Necropolis3rdPoltergeist.description:
Ghosts, Spectres and Poltergeists are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them fly and have {Undead} (undead creature) and {Incorporeal} (50% chance to take no damage when attacked). Spectres also have {Mana Drain} (attacking a spellcasting unit removes 1 of its casts and restores Hit Points equal to 25% of the damage). Poltergeists also have {Ammo Steal} (steals ammunition from enemy shooters: number of Poltergeists / 10 + 1 shots).

Poltergeists dwell in an ancient castle on the shores of Heresh. Above all they hate archers, and they always try to steal every last arrow before the archers can shoot.

See also {Ghost}, {Spectre}.

h5Necropolis3rdSkeletonWarrior.description:
Skeletons, Skeleton Archers and Skeleton Warriors are the level 1 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature). Skeleton Archers also have a ranged attack. Skeleton Warriors also have {Large Shield} (half damage from ranged attacks), {25% Magic Proof} (-25% magic damage), {Shield Bash} (melee attacks have a chance to stun the target, preventing retaliation and resetting its ATB to zero) and {Shield Allies} (adjacent allies take half damage from ranged attacks).

They are the elite of the skeleton light infantry, equipped with sturdy armor and fearsome hammers, and they can quickly turn the tide of battle. Skeleton Warriors do not fear death; one look at their faces leaves no doubt of that.

See also {Skeleton}, {Skeleton Archer}.

Bone Dragons, Spectral Dragons and Horror Dragons are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them fly, are Dragons and have {Undead} (undead creature). Spectral Dragons also have {Cursing Attack} (casts Weakness on the target when attacking) and {Death Stare} (-1 Morale to all enemies). Horror Dragons also have {Sorrow Strike} (casts Sorrow on the target when attacking).

Since no dragons are native to the lands of the Necropolis, the necromancers had to plunder ancient dragon graves and use the remains to build Bone Dragons to do their bidding.

See also {Spectral Dragon}, {Horror Dragon}.

Spectres are restless spirits, forever bound to the wizards who enslaved them. Their bodies are insubstantial, which makes them harder to hit. When these chilling ghosts touch an enemy creature, they drain its mana to restore their own energy.

See also {Ghost}, {Poltergeist}.

h5NecropolisShadowDragon.description:
Bone Dragons, Spectral Dragons and Horror Dragons are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them fly, are Dragons and have {Undead} (undead creature). Spectral Dragons also have {Cursing Attack} (casts Weakness on the target when attacking) and {Death Stare} (-1 Morale to all enemies). Horror Dragons also have {Sorrow Strike} (casts Sorrow on the target when attacking).

Spectral Dragons are not made from the bones of a single kind of dragon. Instead, the skeleton of this undead monster comes from many different dragon breeds: the bones are skillfully pieced together into a single frame, and undead life is infused into it through the sacrifice of higher creatures.

See also {Bone Dragon}, {Horror Dragon}.

Skeleton Warriors also have {Large Shield} (half damage from ranged attacks), {25% Magic Proof} (-25% magic damage), {Shield Bash} (melee attacks have a chance to stun the target, preventing retaliation and resetting its ATB to zero) and {Shield Allies} (adjacent allies take half damage from ranged attacks).

h5NecropolisVampire.description:
Vampires, Vampire Lords and Nosferatu are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature) and {Life Drain} (drains life equal to 50% of the damage dealt and can resurrect creatures in its own stack). Vampires have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Vampire Lords can also teleport and have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Nosferatu can also teleport and have {Sleeping Strike} (melee attacks have a chance to put the target to sleep for 2 rounds; hitting a sleeping target deals maximum damage).

Wizards who sought to escape death chose to become Vampires; they gained eternal youth but were left as hollow, empty shells. All the damage Vampires deal to living creatures goes to sustaining their undying bodies. With centuries of combat experience, they strike so swiftly that no one can retaliate against their attacks.

See also {Vampire Lord}, {Nosferatu}.

h5NecropolisVampireLord.description:
Vampires, Vampire Lords and Nosferatu are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature) and {Life Drain} (drains life equal to 50% of the damage dealt and can resurrect creatures in its own stack). Vampires have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Vampire Lords can also teleport and have {No Enemy Retaliation}. Nosferatu can also teleport and have {Sleeping Strike} (melee attacks have a chance to put the target to sleep for 2 rounds; hitting a sleeping target deals maximum damage).

Some wizards became Vampire Lords in pursuit of powers beyond death, gaining bodies that stay forever young. All the damage Vampire Lords deal to living creatures goes to sustaining their undying bodies, and no one can retaliate against their attacks. Moreover, their ability to teleport makes it impossible to predict where they will strike from.

See also {Vampire}, {Nosferatu}.

h5NecropolisWalkingDead.description:
Walking Dead, Zombies and Rot Zombies are the level 2 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature) and {Enrage} (Attack rises when a friendly stack dies). Zombies also have {Weakening Strike} (attacks give the target -2 Attack and -2 Defense, cumulative). Rot Zombies also have {Festering Aura} (adjacent non-undead stacks get -3 Attack, -2 Defense and -1 Morale).

These rotting corpses have been turned by the wizards' spells into tools for destroying the enemy. Though the Walking Dead are slow and clumsy, they feel neither pain nor fear. To the enemy they are fearsome opponents; to their masters they are ideal “cannon fodder”.

See also {Zombie}, {Rot Zombie}.

h5NecropolisWight.description:
Wights, Wraiths and Banshees are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature). Wraiths also have {Harm Touch} (kills at least 1 creature of the target and dispels its beneficial spells). Banshees also have {Death Wail} (damages living enemies within 3 hexes; the lower their Morale and the closer they are, the more it hurts).

Wights are tormented souls who thirst for revenge on every living creature.

See also {Wraith}, {Banshee}.

h5NecropolisWraith.description:
Wights, Wraiths and Banshees are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature). Wraiths also have {Harm Touch} (kills at least 1 creature of the target and dispels its beneficial spells). Banshees also have {Death Wail} (damages living enemies within 3 hexes; the lower their Morale and the closer they are, the more it hurts).

Wraiths are the embodiment of death; no one can survive their icy touch. The soul of any enemy creature that dares to oppose these undead warriors is drained away.

See also {Wight}, {Banshee}.

h5NecropolisZombie.description:
Walking Dead, Zombies and Rot Zombies are the level 2 units of the Heroes V Necropolis (merged into Necropolis). All of them have {Undead} (undead creature) and {Enrage} (Attack rises when a friendly stack dies). Zombies also have {Weakening Strike} (attacks give the target -2 Attack and -2 Defense, cumulative). Rot Zombies also have {Festering Aura} (adjacent non-undead stacks get -3 Attack, -2 Defense and -1 Morale).

These rotting corpses have been turned by the wizards' spells into tools for destroying the enemy. Zombies feel no pain and can absorb a great deal of damage. In addition, their festering weapons can infect any living being with a wasting disease.

See also {Walking Dead}, {Rot Zombie}.
